parse_contriever_training_options: parse command line arguments for Contriever contrastive retrieval model training and evaluation
initialize_options_parser: initialize an argparse parser with all Contriever training, evaluation, and finetuning arguments
print_and_save_options: print parsed options to console and save them to an opt.txt file in the output directory
configure_contrastive_training: configure MoCo contrastive training parameters including queue size, temperature, and momentum
configure_finetuning_negatives: configure finetuning negative context options including hard negative ratio and minimum index
